description:
Pu Zhi Wei is a Dayi product name, listed here as a ripe pu-erh from Menghai. Little is documented about it beyond that.

Its recipe and leaf grade are not publicly set out. Assume only what is typical of its class: Yunnan large-leaf tea, wet-piled and pressed.

Brew it like other ripe Menghai tea, with a quick rinse, water near the boil and short early steeps. Treat any tasting note attached to the name with caution until you have tried it.

When buying, confirm from the wrapper that it is ripe, and check the batch and production date.
